future_policies.SELECT: path starts with tenant_id where has_active_membership(tenant_id)
future_policies.INSERT: path starts with current_active_tenant() and has_role_in_tenant(tenant,'OPERATOR')

storage.signed_urls: generated server-side only; TTL <= 900s; audit issuance
storage.existing_file_migration: conceptual only; copy-then-swap with checksum; keep legacy path readable until Contract
storage.orphans: quarantine list; human review; never auto-delete
storage.rollback: disable MULTITENANT_STORAGE_ENABLED; policies revert to legacy user_id path
storage.cross_tenant_block: deny path traversal; deny paths not starting with a tenant_id the caller has membership in

future_rules: on tenant switch: unsubscribe all previous channels; resubscribe with new tenant
